first.rationale: Simplifying onboarding directly addresses the 4% completion decline and has prior evidence of improving time-to-value and early adoption, with signup simplification providing supporting activation evidence. Verify memory_86 as the closest precedent and memory_73 as the strongest competing response, because its promotional-pricing result has a pooled-cohort caveat. Favor onboarding unless verification materially changes the evidence; evaluate qualified-revenue and retention signals, not completion alone.
